# Neon Runner

- **Genre:** Endless runner in a neon‑styled HTML canvas.
- **Gameplay:** Player guides a glowing ship through a procedurally generated tunnel, dodging spikes and gaps.
- **Controls:** Arrow keys or WASD to move horizontally and vertically.
- **Lose condition:** Collision with any obstacle or falling off the tunnel ends the game.

1: // Neon Runner – simple endless runner on a canvas with id "game"
2: // Player: glowing ship (square). Controls: Arrow keys / WASD.
3: // Obstacles: moving vertical bars with a gap, scrolling left.
4: 
5: (() => {
6:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
7:   if (!canvas) return;
8:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
9: 
10:   // Resize canvas to fill window
11:   const resize = () => {
12:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
13:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
14:   };
15:   resize();
16:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
17: 
18:   // Player definition
19:   const player = {
20:     // Shape will be drawn as a triangle ship
21:     // dimensions are for collision box
22:     w: 30,
23:     h: 30,
24:     x: 80,
25:     y: canvas.height / 2 - 15,
26:     speed: 4,
27:     color: '#0ff', // neon cyan
28:   };
29:   // Starfield setup
30:   const stars = [];
31:   const initStars = (count = 100) => {
32:     // initialize starfield positions
33:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
34:       stars.push({
35:         x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
36:         y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
37:         size: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
38:         alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5,
39:         speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2,
40:       });
41:     }
42:   };
43:   // Audio setup
44:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
45:   const playBeep = (freq, dur) => {
46:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
47:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
48:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
49:     osc.type = 'sine';
50:     osc.connect(gain);
51:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
52:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
53:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
54:     osc.start();
55:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
56:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
57:   };
58:   const playCollisionSound = () => playBeep(200, 0.2);
59:   // optional background hum
60:   const backgroundHum = () => {
61:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
62:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
63:     osc.frequency.value = 50;
64:     osc.type = 'sine';
65:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.02, audioCtx.currentTime);
66:     osc.connect(gain);
67:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
68:     osc.start();
69:     // keep running; stop when game ends
70:     return () => {
71:       osc.stop();
72:       osc.disconnect();
73:       gain.disconnect();
74:     };
75:   };
76:   const stopHum = backgroundHum();
77:   initStars();
78:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
79:       stars.push({
80:         x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
81:         y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
82:         size: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
83:         alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5,
84:         speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2,
85:       });
86:     }
87:   };
88: 
89: 
90:   // Input handling
91:   const keys = {};
92:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
93:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
94: 
95:   // Obstacle definition – vertical bar with a gap
96:   const obstacles = [];
97:   const obstacleSpacing = 200; // distance between obstacles
98:   const obstacleWidth = 40;
99:   const gapHeight = 150;
100:   let obstacleTimer = 0;
101: 
102:   let gameOver = false;
103: 
104:   const update = () => {
105:     if (gameOver) return;
106:     // Move player based on input
107:     if (keys.ArrowUp || keys.w) player.y -= player.speed;
108:     if (keys.ArrowDown || keys.s) player.y += player.speed;
109:     if (keys.ArrowLeft || keys.a) player.x -= player.speed;
110:     if (keys.ArrowRight || keys.d) player.x += player.speed;
111: 
112:     // Keep player within canvas vertically (falling off ends game)
113:     if (player.y < 0 || player.y + player.h > canvas.height) {
114:       endGame();
115:     }
116: 
117:     // Generate obstacles
118:     obstacleTimer += 1;
119:     if (obstacleTimer * 2 > obstacleSpacing) {
120:       obstacleTimer = 0;
121:       const gapY = Math.random() * (canvas.height - gapHeight);
122:       obstacles.push({
123:         x: canvas.width,
124:         gapY,
125:         passed: false,
126:       });
127:     }
128: 
129:     // Move obstacles leftward
130:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
131:       const o = obstacles[i];
132:       o.x -= 5; // tunnel speed
133:       // Collision detection – player vs upper and lower parts
134:       const upperRect = { x: o.x, y: 0, w: obstacleWidth, h: o.gapY };
135:       const lowerRect = { x: o.x, y: o.gapY + gapHeight, w: obstacleWidth, h: canvas.height - (o.gapY + gapHeight) };
136:       if (rectIntersect(player, upperRect) || rectIntersect(player, lowerRect)) {
137:         endGame();
138:       }
139:       // Remove off‑screen obstacles
140:       if (o.x + obstacleWidth < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
141:     }
142: 
143:     // Update starfield for parallax motion
144:     for (let s of stars) {
145:       s.y += s.speed;
146:       if (s.y > canvas.height) {
147:         s.y = 0;
148:         s.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
149:       }
150:     }
151:   };
152: 
153:   const draw = () => {
154:     // Draw neon gradient background and starfield
155:     const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
156:     gradient.addColorStop(0, '#001');
157:     gradient.addColorStop(1, '#020');
158:     ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
159:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
160:     // Stars
161:     stars.forEach(s => {
162:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
163:       ctx.globalAlpha = s.alpha;
164:       ctx.beginPath();
165:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
166:       ctx.fill();
167:     });
168:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
169: 
170:     // Draw player as neon triangle ship with glow
171:     ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
172:     ctx.shadowColor = player.color;
173:     ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
174:     ctx.beginPath();
175:     ctx.moveTo(player.x, player.y + player.h);
176:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y);
177:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h);
178:     ctx.closePath();
179:     ctx.fill();
180:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
181: 
182:     // Draw obstacles with neon glow
183:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f0f'; // neon magenta
184:     ctx.shadowColor = '#f0f';
185:     ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
186:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
187:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, 0, obstacleWidth, o.gapY);
188:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.gapY + gapHeight, obstacleWidth, canvas.height - (o.gapY + gapHeight));
189:     });
190:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
191:   };
192: 
193:   const loop = () => {
194:     if (!gameOver) {
195:       update();
196:       draw();
197:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
198:     } else {
199:       // Display Game Over
200:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
201:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
202:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
203:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
204:     }
205:   };
206: 
207:   const rectIntersect = (a, b) => {
208:     return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
209:   };
210: 
211:   const endGame = () => {
212:     gameOver = true;
213:   };
214: 
215:   // Start loop
216:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
217: })();
